capture.purpose: current-state schema-only disposable fixture; not historical migration provenance

relations.name: character_illustrations
relations.comment: Creator-managed character portrait and gallery image metadata. Image bytes live in private Storage bucket character-illustrations; private character instructions remain in character_private_info.

relations.name: character_schedule_descriptions
relations.comment: Author-only natural-language schedule descriptions. Raw text is never exposed to public city schedule resolvers.

relations.name: character_schedules
relations.comment: Creator-managed schedule for Encounter mode. Intentionally author-only until a public resolver can enforce all character visibility and age-gate rules.

relations.name: chat_deletion_jobs
relations.comment: Service-role-only durable lifecycle queue for 30-day single/group chat retention. No FK to chat/user parents by design.

relations.name: chat_group_memory_photos
relations.comment: Private memory photos belonging only to their own group; never sourced from individual chats.

relations.name: chat_storage_deletion_jobs
relations.comment: Service-role-only retry queue for chat-memory Storage objects. Bucket allowlist excludes all character assets.

relations.name: content_restriction_terms
relations.comment: Configurable terms used only to prompt creator NSFW review. Admin mutation requires auth.jwt app_metadata role=admin.

relations.name: daily_checkin_settings
relations.comment: Server-controlled daily check-in settings. Adjust reward_silver here; no client write access.

relations.name: daily_checkins
relations.comment: Authoritative daily check-in history, one successful claim per user per Asia/Taipei calendar date.

relations.name: encounter_character_state
relations.comment: Authoritative per-player/per-character Encounter affinity. Client roles may read own rows only; writes are reserved for trusted backend functions.

relations.name: encounter_diary
relations.comment: Private Encounter event summaries scoped to one user and one character. Direct client writes are disabled; trusted backend owns diary creation.

relations.name: encounter_session_evaluation_jobs
relations.comment: Private queue of expired Encounter sessions ready for whole-session AI evaluation. The dispatcher never invents affinity values; a trusted evaluator must call the idempotent settlement RPC.

relations.name: encounter_session_lifecycle
relations.comment: Server-authoritative Encounter schedule window and settlement lifecycle. A paused session remains pending until its snapshotted schedule end; settlement is idempotent per session.

relations.name: story_relationship_batches
relations.comment: One idempotent five-player-turn Story batch per chat session. A completed batch contains both the memory summary and affinity evaluation result.

relations.name: story_relationship_states
relations.comment: One isolated relationship per Story chat session. Encounter carry-over is a frozen starting snapshot; subsequent Story changes never write back to Encounter or sibling Story sessions.

columns.name: storage_path
columns.comment: Private Storage object path: {author_id}/{character_id}/{uuid}.{jpg|jpeg|png|webp}. Never store a public URL.

columns.name: asset_type
columns.comment: primary = one main portrait; gallery = up to five additional illustrations/expression images.

columns.name: sort_order
columns.comment: Primary portrait uses 0; gallery images use unique positions 1..5.

columns.name: display_name
columns.comment: Creator-provided label for a primary or gallery illustration.

columns.name: is_nsfw
columns.comment: Creator-declared adult/sensitive classification; public SELECT is gated by profile birthdate via RLS.

columns.name: avatar_video_path
columns.comment: Path to a private Storage video. Public signed URL access is limited by Storage RLS and character visibility/age policy.

columns.name: personality_profile
columns.comment: Creator-authored structured public character personality. Private author-only details remain in character_private_info.

columns.name: resource_id
columns.comment: Immutable chat session/group ID snapshot; intentionally has no FK to the chat parent.

columns.name: owner_id
columns.comment: Immutable owner ID snapshot; intentionally has no FK to profiles/auth.users.

columns.name: background_mode
columns.comment: Group background: avatar carousel, no background, or a group-owned active unified memory photo.

columns.name: background_memory_photo_id
columns.comment: References chat_memory_photos.id; trigger enforces same-group ownership and active retention status.

columns.name: deleted_at
columns.comment: Lifecycle soft-delete timestamp. Distinct from archived_at; ordinary access and writes must stop immediately when set.

columns.name: chat_mode
columns.comment: Trusted server-assigned mode. Existing sessions default to story; clients must never be allowed to upgrade a session to encounter mode.
